intro: Across 39 articles published between 2026-04-12 and 2026-10-23, ZCyberNews coverage of credential-theft spans activity attributed to AccountDumpling, Aokigahara, and APT41. Reporting references CVE-2021-47928 (CVSS 8.2), CVE-2025-29927, CVE-2025-48703, CVE-2025-55182, and CVE-2025-9501. The affected sectors are technology, software development, cloud services, financial services, and government. Coverage reaches Global, Europe, North america, Bangladesh, and Florida. Of the tagged articles, 29 are rated high severity, 6 critical, 1 medium, and 1 informational.
